notes:
v4.6.79 — Bot runnability + market ownership + real account switching

🐛 FIXED
• Custom bots now get a runnable TAB on the broker they actually support. A bot you marked IBKR-only now appears (and runs) under IBKR instead of being addable-but-never-runnable. Bot tabs and the bot list now use the SAME broker check, which re-reads the bot's own file when needed.
• A bot you uploaded no longer shows an “Install” button anywhere in the market — it's recognised as yours by owner, in every view.
• Deleting a bot you made now also UNPUBLISHES it from the bot market (best-effort owner delete on the server).
• Switching accounts now actually switches: the marketplace (“my bots”), friends, account, admin and tools views all re-fetch with the new account instead of only changing the name in the corner.

Note: your local trading setup (bots, broker keys) is stored per-machine, so trading tabs look the same across accounts on the same computer — only account-scoped (server) data changes.

Update via the in-app banner.
